components.name: Landscape artwork
components.description: The supplied artwork fills the viewport with a portrait crop that retains the circle.
components.css: .ds-landscape { height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; } .ds-landscape picture, .ds-landscape img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-landscape img { object-fit: cover; object-position: 82% 50%; }

narrative.overview: The original artwork is the visual authority: sage hills, a warm sky, fine texture, and a terracotta brushstroke circle. Preserve its composition and detail through the image itself.
keyCharacteristics: The brushstroke circle remains visible in portrait crops.
dos: Do preserve the original image and lossless delivery.
Do verify that the circle remains visible and the page does not scroll at target viewport sizes.
donts: Don't redraw, filter, or overlay the supplied artwork.
Don't add interface elements to this image-only composition without a new brief.
